name: pythia-bpe-32k-v2
supersedes: pythia-bpe-32k-v1 (kept unchanged; existing v1 shards stay under tokenized/pythia-bpe-32k-v1)
byte_alphabet: all 256 byte-level symbols at ids 128-383 (identical to v1)
pretokenizer: Split(scripts.corpus.tokenizer.PRETOKENIZER_REGEX, isolated) + ByteLevel(use_regex=False): single digits keeping their leading space; underscores join following letters; bare _ runs separate
training: python -m scripts.corpus.tokenizer train --vocab 32000 (same 563 MB .tokenizer/sample.txt as v1, fed as ~1 MB document chunks via train_from_iterator so newline+indent merges are learned; tokenizers 0.23.3; retrain reproduces this sha)
heldout_vs_v1: 3.689 vs 3.323 chars/token (-9.9% tokens); bare '_' tokens 0.23% vs 5.84%; Python-token edges on a BPE edge 84.8% vs 84.2%
heldout_note: same disjoint holdout as v1 (25.1M chars, 8,721 records); sha256 in holdout_stats.json
lm_pilot: equal bits/byte to v1 at equal compute (1.0026 vs 0.9977, single seed, gap < noise); see pilot_lm.json
caveat: literal special-token strings inside corpus text are parsed as special tokens; tokenize_corpus excludes such documents
